archetype: Archetype 1 (Organic & Earthy) - Dark Mode Tech Variant

spacing_and_layout.general_spacing: Generous spacing. Gaps between grid items should be gap-6 or gap-8.
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: rounded-2xl for main cards, rounded-xl for inner elements

components.cards: Use 'Crystal Glass' style. bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.2)]. No flat opaque backgrounds for main widgets.
components.buttons: Primary: bg-[#E67E22] text-white hover:bg-[#D35400] transition-colors. Secondary/Ghost: bg-white/10 text-white hover:bg-white/20.
components.inputs: Glass inputs: bg-black/20 border border-white/10 focus:border-[#E67E22] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#E67E22] text-white.
components.tables: Shadcn tables but styled with transparent rows. Hover states on rows: bg-white/5. Ensure high contrast for data text.
components.sidebar: Fixed left, w-64, glassmorphism panel. border-r border-white/10.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All interactive cards/rows should have a subtle -translate-y-1 and border-white/20 glow on hover.
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Fade and slight upward slide for route changes.
motion_and_interactions.list_animations: Staggered fade-in for table rows and dashboard widgets.

icons.style: stroke-width 1.5, desaturated for secondary info, colored for statuses (green/red).

testing_attributes.rule: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="login-submit"`).

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Tailwind CSS for all styling. DO NOT use external CSS files for component styles.
Implement the 'Crystal Glass' effect heavily as requested by user.
For the multi-language toggle (EN/GU), implement a context or state that switches text labels.
Create separate pages/views for Dashboard, Stock, Feed, and Billing.
For PDF export, you can use window.print() styling or a lightweight library like jspdf.
Ensure the sidebar is mobile responsive (hidden off-canvas on mobile with a hamburger menu to toggle it).
Use Shadcn UI components but heavily customize them to fit the glassmorphic dark theme.
Replace generic fonts with Outfit (headings) and IBM Plex Sans (body) via Google Fonts in index.html.
Build the dashboard using the 'Control Room' grid strategy for maximum density and data correlation.
